fields.v: Evaluates; secondary: Proposes an evaluation method — repository mining: qualitative content analysis of 91 project-level agent rule files (e.g. CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md) collected at Google in late July 2025, yielding a normative taxonomy of desirable agent behaviours (4 expectations / 15 attributes) as a basis for evaluations beyond correctness

fields.v: Project-level rule file with custom instructions and behavioural guidelines steering how the agent approaches tasks in a codebase. Observed content per taxonomy: 1 Adhere to Standards and Processes (best practices, project workflows/conventions); 2 Ensure Code Quality and Reliability (style, readable/maintainable, robust/performant); 3 Solve Problems Effectively (understand context, work incrementally, validate proactively, task focus, infer intent, learn by example); 4 Collaborate with the Developer (communicate, seek help, plan collaboratively and analyse trade-offs, learn from feedback, e.g., lessons_learned.md)
